{{Quote|All right, Padija. Where are your friends?''"<br />"''We're supposed to meet them on the corner of Bith and Kossh streets.|Drake Paulsen and Padija Anjeri|<ref name="II">{{JournalCite|12|Idol Intentions}}</ref>}}
'''Kossh street''' was located in [[Capital City (Omman)|Capital City]] on [[Omman Minor]]. It was connected to [[Bith street]]. When [[Padija Anjeri]] hired [[Drake Paulsen]] to transport her and some colleagues off-world, they were due to meet at the corner of Kossh and Bith streets.<ref name="II" />
